name: Disco Polo
summary: Beyond the music, Disco Polo is defined by a distinct and highly recognizable visual aesthetic, both celebrated and criticized for its kitsch value.
description: Beyond the music, Disco Polo is defined by a distinct and highly recognizable visual aesthetic, both celebrated and criticized for its kitsch value. This includes the fashion of its performers and fans ( Discopolowcy ), as well as the unique visual style of its low-budget music videos and album art, which are a hallmark of Polish post-communist, early-capitalist pop culture. The term "Disco Polo" was coined in 1993 as a tongue-in-cheek Polish answer to Italo Disco . [ 1 ]
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Love, celebration, joy, nostalgia, hedonism, provincial pride

visualDNA.colour: Vibrant and often clashing colors, neons, metallics (gold, silver)
